Recipe:
Teriyaki Sauce 1 Cup A VanOrman Original
§ion;
One night, we started making Teriyaki chicken, then we found we didn't have any Teriyaki sauce. So, Ransom did a little research, tried a few things and we came up with this.
Brown Sugar½ Cup Soy Sauce½ Cup Rice Vinegar2 Tablespoons Sesame Oil1 Tablespoon
GingerFresh, Grated ½ teaspoon
GarlicMinced ½ teaspoon
Place all ingredients in a small pot and mix.
Heat on medium heat until it comes to a boil.
Remove immediately and let cool.
Due to the high sugar content, this recipe will easily overflow if you let it boil for very long at all.
Use ½ Cup Corn Syrup instead of Brown Sugar.
